ideas.title: The Impact of Government Funding on Social Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of recent government funding decisions on social programs, including Head Start.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to examine the impact of funding decisions on vulnerable populations.
questions: What are the specific funding decisions being made?
How will these decisions impact social programs?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it could highlight the human impact of government funding decisions and hold those in power accountable for their actions.
